message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.

Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 272, "amount_cents": 17238}, {"order_id": 274, "amount_cents": 1382}, {"order_id": 275, "amount_cents": 2304}]

hold_reason: Refund discrepancy for order 272: the ledger shows 17238 cents applied, but the signed batch order requested 8656 cents (overage 8582 cents). Orders 274 and 275 match. Alpha's refund work is not correct, so no payouts have been recorded. Needs review and correction of the order 272 refund before payouts.

reply.thought: The handoff shows order 272 with 17238 cents applied against 8656 cents requested, an overage of 8582 cents. Before holding, I'll check the ledger's refund records to confirm the discrepancy.

The ledger confirms that order 272 has a 17238-cent refund applied, but the batch only requested 8656 cents. That is an 8582-cent over-refund, so paying out on the current ledger could overpay the customer. Holding the batch for human review before any payout is recorded.
